notes:
Custom title bar for the main window
Video player opens many more formats (MXF, raw HEVC/H.264, AV1, DV, WTV and more), stream addresses and All files
Browser extension 2.6.1: the video button lists the page's streams, catches disguised HLS/DASH streams, and stays on top of ad layers
Stream downloads are faster and steadier, and the speed shown follows the data as it arrives
Data saver (on by default): nothing is downloaded twice; turn it off to have stalled stream pieces fetched again alongside
Options: close button in the top right corner
